selectors: Cable Network Programming: three-month financial table
sources.scope: Selected issuer exhibit; segment EBITDA is not cash or standalone service profit.

sources.publisher: ITV plc / London Stock Exchange RNS
selectors: Printed pp34-35: segment revenue, group eliminations and EBITA
sources.scope: Selected PDF tables visually inspected; internal trading includes intra-Studios activity as specified in source notes.

supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Performance-date demand, utilization and contribution after artist/venue costs
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: Tickets sold early are not completed performances or distributable profit.

supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Retained fees and contract economics after client-service and platform costs
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: Gross transaction value, deferred fees and recognized revenue need matching transaction and period scopes.

supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Contracted value attached to the event/venue base
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: Do not count the same fan, venue or event as independent confirmation three times.

supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Retained distribution/advertising receipts after rights and production costs
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: Subscriber erosion and content-cost timing can offset repricing; segment profit is not title-level return.

supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Event-adjusted advertising and recurring distribution economics
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: Event calendars and political cycles prevent automatic extrapolation of one quarter.

supplemental_business_rows.economic_role: Service-level mechanisms inside broader issuer reporting
supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Evidence of incremental paid or ad-supported contribution
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: No separate service financial weight or profit is inferred from a group or segment total.

supplemental_business_rows.research_question: External commissions, repeat licensing and retained intellectual-property contribution
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: Internal trading, delivery phasing and cost allocation can conceal external-demand weakness.

supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Advertising yield and retained digital customer contribution
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: Digital revenue is within M&E, not a third additive issuer segment.

supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Contribution translated at defined FX assumptions
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: Management sensitivity for a named horizon is not an estimated stock beta or permanent coefficient.

supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Matched-technology activation, retained contribution and deployment-to-cash timing
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: FTTx lines are not FTTH customers; retail/wholesale and homes-passed denominators differ.

supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Local service contribution, investment and financing
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: Issuer domicile cannot substitute for economic geography or a country-level breakdown.

supplemental_business_rows.economic_role: Parent claim on a consolidated operating business
supplemental_business_rows.research_question: Attributable earnings and cash after minority, funding and currency effects
supplemental_business_rows.limitation: Do not add this consolidated exposure to the same subsidiary business as if independent end-demand.

cases.name: Q2 2026 AOI segment reconciliation
cases.meaning: Issuer adjusted measure, not GAAP operating profit or independent growth confirmations.

cases.name: AOI change, Q2 2026 versus Q2 2025
cases.meaning: Opposite role trajectories reconcile to one group outcome.

cases.name: June 30 issuer free-cash proxy
cases.meaning: Reproduces company non-GAAP balance proxy; not cash legally available to distribute.

cases.name: Q2 adjusted free-cash-flow reconciliation
cases.meaning: Uses maintenance capex and company adjustments, not all-investment equity cash.

cases.name: Cable EBITDA change
cases.meaning: Reported segment reconciliation, not the causal profit attributable to one sporting event.

cases.name: Television EBITDA change
cases.meaning: One quarter, not an annualized sustainable cash flow.

cases.name: Studios total-revenue change
cases.meaning: An increase in total activity need not indicate higher external receipts.

cases.name: 2025 H1 external group revenue
cases.meaning: Prior-year group internal amount is 263, not the Studios-only 261.

cases.name: Group adjusted EBITA change
cases.meaning: Mixed component performance; flat adjusted group result does not mean every business was flat.

cases.name: Group adjusted EBITA / external group revenue
cases.meaning: Source-compatible group denominator. Not the same basis as Studios-only margin or another issuer EBITDA.

cases.name: US segment revenue / group revenue
cases.meaning: Approximation of reported 65.7% segment share, not security-country exposure or shareholder-cash ownership.

cases.name: Displayed segment revenue reconciliation
cases.meaning: A one-million displayed residual is retained, not filled with a made-up activity.

cases.name: Displayed EBITDA after leases reconciliation
cases.meaning: Printed residual retained; accounting lease adjustment is not cash lease-principal payment.

cases.name: FTTx/FTTH denominator mismatch
cases.numerator_label: 21.0 million fiber-based lines; FTTx; retail and wholesale
cases.reason: Technology, population and customer/coverage measures differ. Do not emit a penetration ratio.

cases.name: Management FX sensitivity scope
cases.basis: internal forecasts; all other variables held constant
cases.meaning: Do not convert a conditional management sensitivity into a permanent or causally estimated stock coefficient.
